text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a brilliant victory in the 
Oka Sho, Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Become "Number One" once again. She boldly 
declared that she would claim victory in 
any race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she took her next step onto the 
path of the Triple Tiara, heading toward 
the second leg: the Yushun Himba (Oaks).
